programs.description: An ancient temple is neglected to ruins and is tended only by the Velichappadu. When the priest goes on a leave, a young man takes up his job and forms a relationship with the Velichappadu's daughter.
An ex-convict's fresh start to life is threatened by vengeful enemies, compelling him to confront the dangers for a chance at freedom.
Shakeela, who is from a rich family, marries Abdul, a poor man. Problems start brewing in their life when she comes to know that he is suffering from autism.
Joji, a motorcycle enthusiast, is the youngest son of a well-known man named Kora Sahib. When Joji is falsely accused of murder, he tries to prove his innocence with the support of his father.
When Unnimol, a young girl child, faces dismissal from all her relatives and community, Lord Ayyappan takes the form of a school student to help her overcome obstacles.

Parvathy, a young woman, falls in love with Sivankutty, a lineman, but her mother disapproves of her relationship. Shortly after, her father returns after 18 years and fixes her marriage to an engineer.
Maheshwar struggles to raise Malu, his 5-year-old daughter, who holds him responsible for her mother's passing. Ganga attempts to mend the rift between them.
A loyal army chief safeguards his kingdom from both internal and external threats, earning royal accolades. Framed for treason, he is exiled but continues to protect the throne.
When Unnimol, a young girl child, faces dismissal from all her relatives and community, Lord Ayyappan takes the form of a school student to help her overcome obstacles.
Love blooms between Sruthy, a cheerful girl from a humble background and Ashwin, an arrogant wealthy businessman when they accidentally come across each other.
Gautham, an IPS officer, is forced to marry Alakananda, an aspiring doctor. However, when his first love reenters his life, he is forced to choose between his past and his future.
While juggling her roles of being a great teacher and a devoted mother, a woman remains desperate for the affection she has always yearned for but never received.
A young woman faces constant torment and oppression from her family, but remains resilient in her search for love and happiness.
A father's decision to remarry brings unexpected struggles as his son Sethumadhavan steps up to care for his half-sisters, navigating shifting family relationships.
Elderly couple's spirits lift as their grandchild visits, mending the rift caused by their only son's unwelcome marriage and move to the States.
Though separated, a husband and wife still love each other but hide their true feelings out of fear of rejection. They are then forced to confront their emotions or risk losing each other forever.
When the past of a middle-aged unmarried businessman confronts him, it affects his unusual romantic relationship with a younger girl.
Kalyani, who is speech impaired, is disliked by everyone in her family, except her mother. As she longs for her father's affection, Kiran enters her life.
An anthology of three stories. The first story involves a murder investigation, the second story is about a group of goons following a girl, the third involves five friends delivering a package.
